pages.text: $(thing)Gray Mold$() ($(o)Botrytis cinerea$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() tomato, lettuce, pea, common bean, sunflower, onion, cabbage.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() airborne spores.
$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-25 °C (best 20 °C), humidity above 90%, 8 h of wet leaves.
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 30% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Ventilation; Remove infected tissue; Avoid late overhead watering.
